independence: No candidate, profile, earlier run, research implementation or other arm material was read. Only the parent-fixed requester envelope, current canonical skill, permitted neutral files, general knowledge and directly viewed face/hair reference are authoring inputs.
random_method: One cryptographic 63-bit integer from secrets.randbits; option index = integer modulo five. Options were independently authored before the draw; no candidate data participated.

options.situation: A commuter repairs a damaged borrowed folio at a public library mending table during a rain closure; a staff member must pass it on before the courier cart leaves.
A worker at a municipal greenhouse shelter catches a slipping carton of seedlings while a visitor holds the doorway clear after a sudden squall.
In a small ferry waiting room during a delayed departure, a traveler helps a second passenger fasten a luggage strap while the attendant starts opening the boarding gate.
At a late commuter station lost-property counter, a traveler identifies a canvas bag by a broken strap while the clerk searches a crowded return cart.
At a neighborhood bakery loading hatch, a worker rescues a paper-wrapped bread order from a collapsing wet crate while the customer steadies its top.

selected.situation: In a small ferry waiting room during a delayed departure, a traveler helps a second passenger fasten a luggage strap while the attendant starts opening the boarding gate.

reference_observation: Dark chin-length bob with a soft side part and fine loose fringe; visible oval face, dark rounded eyes, straight delicate brows, small nose and softly defined lips. These are visible appearance cues, not identity, actual age, biography, personality or body-size evidence.

primary_authorial_comparison.realization: Seated traveler turns toward a waist-high suitcase on the adjacent bench; a second passenger steadies it and the ferry attendant lifts the gate behind them.
primary_authorial_comparison.assessment: The seated reach lets the face, open wool layer, scarf, forearms and fastening contact coexist in one quiet, warm foreground. Waiting-room traces and boarding movement make the urgency understandable. Subtle everyday attraction is carried by focused presence and close, gentle observation.

primary_authorial_comparison.realization: A wide corridor view from the boarding queue, with the traveler kneeling beside a floor suitcase and other passengers streaming past.
primary_authorial_comparison.assessment: The queue would make the time pressure more forceful, but the high density and distant face would make the central fastening relation and face/hair reference less available. It also encourages spectacle rather than the chosen intimate public moment.

chosen_direction: The first realization: a close environmental photograph of absorbed helpfulness at the instant departure resumes. Material/color contrasts organize attention without converting every garment into an isolated demonstration.

theme.who: A fictional traveler guided by visible reference face/hair helps another passenger restore a closed luggage strap.
theme.where: A small coastal ferry waiting room constrains space but offers a bench at practical hand height.
theme.how: A nearby observer at the seated traveler's face height sees a three-quarter body angle and literal hand-to-buckle contact.
theme.why_now: The wet umbrella rack and delayed room suggest recent rain; the attendant opening the boarding gate makes the repaired closure consequential immediately.

lock_intent: The actual requester owns reference use and a complex, testable photographic situation. Ferry travel, people count, help gesture, garment choices, material colors and camera are agent-owned realizations and stay open.
